```text
# #4011: Patch (part 10 of 20): the publicly cached API responses are the same for every caller, with a test (cache poisoning)
Opened by @jgoetzmann.

### What it does

Item 10 of #3897: **cache poisoning**. A cache keyed on the URL stores a response shaped by a header it didn't key on, and serves it to everyone. First-pass verdict: 🔍 to check.

Every API response is `no-store` except those sent through `cached_ok` (`crates/server/src/api/stats.rs`), which says `public, max-age=…`. These are its six callers:

- `api/stats.rs`, lines 1322, 1354, 1450, 1520 and 1636;
- `api/ci_runs.rs`, line 309.

1. **A test per route.** The same path and query must give a byte-identical body whatever else the request carries:
   - signed in or not (`Authorization`);
   - `Accept-Language`;
   - `Cookie`;
   - `X-Forwarded-Host`, `X-Forwarded-For`, `X-Original-URL` and `X-Rewrite-URL`;
   - an unknown query parameter.
2. **No caller in any of them.** None of these routes reads the caller, so a later change can't make one personal while it stays public. Say so in `cached_ok`'s doc comment.
3. **Nothing caches `/api/*` in front.** No Cloudflare Cache Rule caches `/api/*` (`infra/cloudflare.tf` has none today), and the Worker (`apps/edge/src`) never calls the Cache API for it. If there is a config test that fits, add the check there.

### Acceptance

- The per-route tests pass, and `cached_ok`'s comment states the rule.
- `cargo test -p jackioh-server` and the whole-workspace gates green.

### Blocked by, part of

Part of #3897.

### Difficulty (a guess)

medium: anything that is not hard

### Who does it

The night bot (bot:build)

<!-- jackioh-bot:plan -->
## Plan

_Written by `muse` (muse, `muse-spark-1.3-contributor`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/43989108558)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

Six public routes send their bodies through `cached_ok` (`crates/server/src/api/stats.rs`), which marks them `public, max-age=…`, so shared caches key on the URL alone. Done means each of those six routes has a test proving the same path and query yields a byte-identical body whatever else the request carries (auth, language, cookies, forward/rewrite headers, unknown query params); `cached_ok`'s doc comment states the no-caller rule; and the edge config test pins that nothing in front (`infra/cloudflare.tf`, `wrangler.jsonc`, the Worker, `_headers`) caches `/api/*`.

## Files to touch

| File | New / change | What changes |
|---|---|---|
| `crates/server/src/api/stats.rs` | change | Doc comment on `cached_ok` (line 537): the no-caller rule |
| `crates/server/tests/api/stats.rs` | change | New `mod cache_poisoning`: a `get_with` helper plus five per-route tests |
| `crates/server/tests/api/ci_runs.rs` | change | New `mod cache_poisoning`: one test for `GET /api/stats/ci` |
| `apps/edge/src/config.test.ts` | change | New `#4011` describe block: four front-cache checks |

Must not touch: anything under `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/` or `bot/`; `infra/cloudflare.tf` (read-only evidence, it already has no cache rules); `spec/` and `spec/rulings/` (no game-rules decision here, so no ruling note); the private `get_player`/`put_player` handlers. Governing code: `crates/server/src/api/http.rs` (`Req`, `json_response`'s `no-store` default), `crates/server/src/app.rs` route table (`AuthLevel::None` on all six), `apps/edge/src/routing.ts` (`forServer`, `SERVER_ROUTES`), `wrangler.jsonc`, `apps/web/public/_headers`. No spec section governs HTTP caching.

## Steps

1. Re-verify the six call sites and their caller-blindness. Run `grep -n "cached_ok" crates/server/src/api/stats.rs crates/server/src/api/ci_runs.rs` (expect the definition plus call sites at `get_cards`, `get_games`, `get_card`, `get_play_rates`, `get_players`, `get_ci_runs`) and `grep -n "req\.headers\|req\.caller\|caller_of\|caller_profile\|req\.address\|req\.body" crates/server/src/api/stats.rs crates/server/src/api/ci_runs.rs` (expect hits only in `get_player`/`put_player`, which use `ok_of`, never `cached_ok`). Confirm all six routes declare `AuthLevel::None` in `crates/server/src/app.rs` (lines 686–733), so `dispatch` never resolves a caller for them.
2. In `crates/server/src/api/stats.rs`, add a doc comment on `cached_ok` stating exactly this rule: only `AuthLevel::None` routes whose handlers never read the caller may use it — no `req.caller`, `caller_of`/`caller_profile`, `Authorization`, `Cookie`, `Accept-Language`, `X-Forwarded-*`, `X-Original-URL`/`X-Rewrite-URL`, or any other caller-carried header, and unknown query params must stay ignored — because the answer is served from shared caches keyed on the URL alone, so anything caller-shaped would poison every later caller. Keep the signature `pub(crate) fn cached_ok(body: Value, max_age_seconds: i64) -> Response` unchanged.
3. In `crates/server/tests/api/stats.rs`, add `mod cache_poisoning` (pattern: the existing `mod r654_public_card_and_player_stats` at line 274; reuse `test_app`, `USER_TOKEN`, `make_game_record`, `RecordOptions`, `insert_records`, `seed_profile`, `put_player_stats`, `cache_control`). Add helper `get_with(app: &Arc<App>, path: &str, token: Option<&str>, headers: &[(&str, &str)]) -> (u16, HeaderMap, Value)`: build with `json_request("GET", path, &Value::Null, token, None)` from `crate::support::deps`, insert each extra header via `HeaderValue::from_str`, send with `deps::send`. Add `use axum::http::HeaderValue;` and import `json_request, send`. Each test requests 7 variants and asserts status 200, `cache-control` is `public, max-age=<route TTL>`, and `serde_json::to_string(&body)` is identical across all 7 (equal `Value`s serialize to the exact bytes `cached_ok` sends, so this is byte-identity). The 7 variants: (a) bare; (b) `Some(USER_TOKEN)`; (c) `Accept-Language: fr-FR`; (d) `Cookie: sid=abc`; (e) `X-Forwarded-Host: evil.example` + overridden `X-Forwarded-For: 203.0.113.9` + `X-Original-URL: /api/admin` + `X-Rewrite-URL: /api/admin`; (f) unknown query param appended (`?` or `&` plus `poison=1`); (g) all of b–e at once. Seed one record first with `insert_records(&app, vec![make_game_record("poison-1", RecordOptions::default())]).await;`.
4. Write the five tests: `cache_poisoning_cards_same_bytes_whatever_the_caller_carries` (`/api/stats/cards`, TTL `CARD_STATS_CACHE_TTL_SECONDS`); `cache_poisoning_card_same_bytes_whatever_the_caller_carries` (`/api/stats/cards/core-001`, same TTL); `cache_poisoning_play_rates_same_bytes_whatever_the_caller_carries` (`/api/stats/play-rates`, TTL `PLAY_RATES_REFRESH_SECONDS`); `cache_poisoning_games_same_bytes_whatever_the_caller_carries` (`/api/stats/games`, TTL `CARD_STATS_CACHE_TTL_SECONDS`); `cache_poisoning_players_same_bytes_whatever_the_caller_carries` (`/api/stats/players`, TTL `PLAYER_STATS_CACHE_TTL_SECONDS`, seed one public player by copying the Alice `seed_profile` + `put_player_stats` block at lines 829–852).
5. In `crates/server/tests/api/ci_runs.rs`, add `mod cache_poisoning` reusing `run`, `job`, `runs`, `call`, `test_app`, `CI_RUNS_CACHE_TTL_SECONDS`. Test `cache_poisoning_ci_runs_same_bytes_whatever_the_caller_carries`: can with `answer_runs(runs(vec![run(7, 1, "completed", Some("success"))]))` (a passed run, so no jobs are read), then the same 7 header/query variants as step 3 built on `json_request` + `send` (import both from `crate::support::deps`; for the signed-in variant any Bearer [REDACTED] works since the route is `AuthLevel::None` — use `"e2e-token-p1"`), asserting 200, `public, max-age=120`, and identical serialized bodies.
6. In `apps/edge/src/config.test.ts`, add `describe("#4011 nothing in front caches /api/*", …)` following the file's existing `readFileSync(join(ROOT, …))` pattern: (a) raw `wrangler.jsonc` text does not match `/cache/i`; (b) `infra/cloudflare.tf` text does not match `/cache/i` (today it has no cache-rule, page-rule or ruleset resource at all); (c) `apps/edge/src/index.ts` plus `routing.ts` text does not match `/\bcaches\b/` nor `/cacheTtl|cacheEverything/i` (the Worker never calls the Cache API; its only `Cache-Control` write is the wasm module's in `precompressedModule`); (d) `apps/web/public/_headers` text does not match `/^\/api/m` (its only cache blocks are `/*`, `/fonts/*`, `/assets/*`).
7. Run: `cargo fmt --check`; `cargo test -p jackioh-server --test server api::stats::cache_poisoning`; `cargo test -p jackioh-server --test server api::ci_runs::cache_poisoning`; `cargo clippy -p jackioh-server --all-targets -- -D warnings`; `pnpm --dir apps/edge test src/config.test.ts`; `cargo jackioh spec check`. Confirm each new test fails without its guard (e.g. temporarily reading a header into the body is not required — instead verify sensitivity by dropping one variant's assertion mentally; the honest check is that all 7 variants actually differ in what they send, which the helper guarantees).

## Tests

- `crates/server/tests/api/stats.rs`, `mod cache_poisoning`: the five `cache_poisoning_*_same_bytes_whatever_the_caller_carries` tests above; each asserts 200 + `public, max-age=<TTL>` + one identical serialized body across 7 header/query variants. Command: `cargo test -p jackioh-server --test server api::stats::cache_poisoning`.
- `crates/server/tests/api/ci_runs.rs`, `mod cache_poisoning`: `cache_poisoning_ci_runs_same_bytes_whatever_the_caller_carries`, same shape against canned GitHub data. Command: `cargo test -p jackioh-server --test server api::ci_runs::cache_poisoning`.
- `apps/edge/src/config.test.ts`, `#4011` describe: four static assertions over `wrangler.jsonc`, `infra/cloudflare.tf`, the Worker's sources, and `_headers`. Command: `pnpm --dir apps/edge test src/config.test.ts`.

## Done when

- [ ] All six cached routes have a per-route byte-identical-body test covering signed-in, `Accept-Language`, `Cookie`, the four forward/rewrite headers, and an unknown query param, and each passes.
- [ ] `cached_ok`'s doc comment states the no-caller rule.
- [ ] The edge config test pins no `/api/*` caching in front (tf, wrangler, Worker source, `_headers`) and passes.
- [ ] `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy -p jackioh-server --all-targets -- -D warnings`, both server test filters, the edge file test, and `cargo jackioh spec check` are green.

## Risks

- Kept server-side cells (`kept_window`, play-rates/CI kept answers) mean a repeat request can pass even if a future handler reads a header after the cache lookup; the tests still catch any header-dependent body built per request, which is the poisoning vector that matters, and the doc comment bars adding such reads.
- Varying `X-Forwarded-For` changes the rate-limit address hash, not the body; a fresh `test_app()` per test plus 7 sequential requests stays far under the limiter, but keep one app per test, not one shared across tests.
- `serde_json::to_string` equality stands in for wire bytes; it is exact here because `cached_ok` sends `body.to_string()` of a deterministically-serialized `Value`.
- The `/cache/i` tripwires on config files will fire on any future legitimate key containing "cache"; that is deliberate — the builder of that change must then consciously reaffirm `/api/*` stays uncached.

## Open questions

- None. Every check the task asks for fits a file the bot may change; `infra/cloudflare.tf` needs reading only, since it already contains no cache rules.
```
